currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific existing Arrowhead Stadium in neutral NFL configuration: own native saddle-profile red bowl with lower/middle/upper banks and closed club belts, pale radial aisles, apron/green field/red end zones/neutral yard lines/yellow goal forks, two oval supported end displays and curled sideline press/gallery roofs with exposed concrete frame. White-panel end entrances with large trapezoidal glazing, four round ramp towers/open oculi/visible near helical surfaces and supported native corner access strips complete the enclosure. No copied team/sponsor lettering, logos, screen content, crowd or private texture. Detached practice facility and neighboring Kauffman Stadium remain native. Future proposed replacement/renovation and temporary soccer conversion are outside the NFL reference configuration.
